claims.head: Coyle’s line gets the soft minutes
claims.call: The Blue Jackets’ L1 (Coyle, Olivier and Sillinger) spends at least 42% of its 5-on-5 time against the Rangers’ second line.
claims.body: At home, the Blue Jackets keep sending Coyle’s line (Coyle, Olivier and Sillinger) out against opponents’ second lines, far more often than chance would. That’s Rick Bowness chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Rangers’ second line is Miller, Dorofeyev and Kartye.
claims.nums: At home: 42% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against second lines, about 24% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Bowness likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Rangers’ second line.

claims.body: The Blue Jackets’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Rangers’ power play is one of the league’s best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Blue Jackets tonight.

notes.text: S. Durzi has started killing penalties: on the ice for 44% of the team’s shorthanded time in 6 games, up from 7% last season.
Z. Werenski is out long term (shoulder injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
I. Provorov is on injured reserve (lower body injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-four defenseman. C. Soucy has taken his spot beside D. Mateychuk.
D. Severson returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
D. Heinen has started killing penalties: on the ice for 32% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 5% last season.
